description: North and south of house already name windows; WINDOWS must parse to the boarded window.

replacements.old:
<OBJECT BOARDED-WINDOW
	(IN LOCAL-GLOBALS)
        (SYNONYM WINDOW)
	(ADJECTIVE BOARDED)
	(DESC "boarded window")
	(FLAGS NDESCBIT)
	(ACTION SURFACE-BOARDED-WINDOW-F)>
replacements.new:
<OBJECT BOARDED-WINDOW
	(IN LOCAL-GLOBALS)
        (SYNONYM WINDOW WINDOWS)
	(ADJECTIVE BOARDED)
	(DESC "boarded window")
	(FLAGS NDESCBIT)
	(ACTION SURFACE-BOARDED-WINDOW-F)>
